scope: ADXL345 fixed Apache Mynewt SPI task. Core RTOS contract is HAL SPI controller setup, mode 3/8-bit/MSB-first at up to 5 MHz, blocking full-duplex register write/read and burst-read, with SPI0 and board-provided CS.

hal_spi_init.signature: int hal_spi_init(int spi_num, void *cfg, uint8_t spi_type)
hal_spi_init.semantics: 0 success; nonzero failure; master selected with HAL_SPI_TYPE_MASTER

hal_spi_config.semantics: Call after init and while SPI is disabled; 0 success/nonzero failure

hal_spi_enable.semantics: Enables controller; does not begin a transfer; 0 success/nonzero failure

hal_spi_txrx.signature: int hal_spi_txrx(int spi_num, void *txbuf, void *rxbuf, int cnt)
hal_spi_txrx.semantics: Blocking master full-duplex transfer; txbuf cannot be NULL; rxbuf is optional; cnt counts 8-bit values for 8-bit word size; 0 success/nonzero failure

api_declarations_checked.hal_spi_init: int hal_spi_init(int spi_num, void *cfg, uint8_t spi_type)
api_declarations_checked.hal_spi_txrx: int hal_spi_txrx(int spi_num, void *txbuf, void *rxbuf, int cnt)

strict_v2_semantic_check.rule: C requires necessary argument/data direction/return or units and task-fixed bus to be usable; full generated signatures and context bindings were read.

facts.requirement: Expose hal/hal_spi.h, struct hal_spi_settings with data-mode/order/word-size/baudrate fields, and the SPI controller handle/number.
Expose hal_spi_init/config/enable with proper signatures and master setup, then configure mode 3, MSB-first, 8-bit words and baudrate no greater than 5 MHz before transfers.

Expose blocking full-duplex SPI transfer with controller, tx/rx pointers and count; tx is required, rx may be NULL, count is 8-bit words for this task. Return is zero on success and nonzero on failure; reference performs 2-byte writes and reads plus a 7-byte burst.
Preserve SPI controller 0, polling mode and board-configured chip select from this fixed task package.
